assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setback), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: This package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation. No building floor area or height conclusions are asserted.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key-area polygons are provisional rough boundaries from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas and ratios in metrics.json are recomputed from provisional geometry in EPSG:4548 and must be recalculated when official polygons are published. Provisional geometry blocks formal professional scoring until replaced.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual schematic polygons illustrating design intent (retain/renovate/new logic), not measured building stock.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm is a low-confidence schematic value and must not be read as construction scale.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios, events, operations, and brand elements are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen; they are not approved government arrangements, investment commitments, or confirmed implementation.
